items.title: Frozen
items.line: In theaters from 27 November 2013 and still everywhere in 2014. It grossed over $1.28 billion, and Let It Go won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

items.title: Flappy Bird
items.line: Out since May 2013, it hit the top of the app charts in January 2014 and reportedly earned about $50,000 a day in ads. Dong Nguyen pulled it on 10 February.

items.title: Ice Bucket Challenge
items.line: Summer 2014. More than 1.2 million videos were shared on Facebook between 1 June and 13 August, and over $115 million was raised for ALS that year.

items.title: Serial
items.line: The podcast launched 3 October 2014. Sarah Koenig reopened the 1999 killing of Hae Min Lee, and it was reported as the fastest podcast to 5 million iTunes downloads.

items.title: Brazil 1-7 Germany
items.line: 8 July 2014, Belo Horizonte. Germany led 5-0 after 29 minutes and won 7-1, Brazil's worst World Cup defeat. Klose took the all-time record for World Cup goals.

items.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
items.line: Opened 1 August 2014. James Gunn filled it with 1960s and 70s songs, Chris Pratt played Star-Lord, and it grossed about $773 million.
